defaults.note: Identical to the FaceIt defaults; every mode but Retake holds 10 players.

plugins.name: HeroShift
plugins.note: cs2-hero-shift build: single self-contained DLL (CounterStrikeSharp.API is PrivateAssets, no bundled dependency DLLs, no gamedata/languages).

plugins.name: RayTrace
plugins.note: Built from Juzlus/Ray-Trace. Two layers: the native Metamod module and the CSS RayTraceImpl plugin + RayTraceApi shared assembly. Mounted only in this mode so other modes stay free of it.

mounts.note: This CS2 image's engine returns an empty GetGameDir() at Metamod load, so RayTrace's native module resolves its gamedata to the absolute path /addons/RayTrace/gamedata.json. Libs are still found in-memory by name, so only gamedata needs this.

plugins.name: PanelBridge
plugins.note: Shared single copy in manager/shared/plugins/PanelBridge, built from the project below. Exposes SteamID64 player data over RCON for the panel.

configs.name: server.cfg
configs.note: Shared base profile in manager/shared/cfg/server.cfg, mounted into every mode and exec'd first by mode_heroshift.cfg. Mode files carry only their own convars on top of it.

configs.name: skillsInfo.json
configs.note: Editable skill roster the panel writes (/api/v3/modes/heroshift/skills). Lives where the upstream release ships it, inside the plugin folder, and reaches the container through the HeroShift plugin directory mount — it needs no mount of its own.

configs.name: config.json
configs.note: HeroShift plugin config (HUD, chat, commands, timings). Same story as skillsInfo.json: upstream location, carried by the plugin directory mount. The panel edits a whitelisted subset of its toggles.

actions.label: Reload Hero Config
actions.description: Reloads HeroShift's skillsInfo.json / config.json; the container stays running.

actions.label: Restart Current Game
actions.description: Resets the in-game match after one second. The container stays running.

actions.label: End Warmup
actions.description: Ends warmup and starts normal round flow.

actions.label: Kick All Bots
actions.description: Removes every bot from the active game.
